annotations.title: Relationships between companies, investors and people

description: Returns the filed relationships around a company, an investment house or a person, private companies included (Anthropic, OpenAI): owns, invests_in, insider_of, holds_rights_in, customer_of, agreement_with, acquired, lends_to — each with the filings that prove it. `depth: 2` adds the neighbours' relationships; `notes` in the answer says how to read each field. Use it when the user asks how companies are connected, who is behind a company, its customers, suppliers or lenders, or what links two of them. For a full shareholder list, use get_ownership; for one investor's portfolio, get_holders.

center.description: The company, house or person at the center: a ticker, a company name (listed or not: 'Anthropic'), a holder's key or name ('vanguard', 'Elon Musk'), or a typed id from a previous answer (company:nvda, holder:vanguard, person:<id>, gov:us).

depth.description: 1 (default): the center's relationships; 2: its neighbours' too.

limit.description: How many relationships at most (default 40, max 200).

minShare.description: Minimum share of capital, as a fraction (0.01 = 1%), for ownership relationships.

natures.description: Comma-separated natures within the view: owns, invests_in, holds_rights_in, insider_of, customer_of, agreement_with, acquired, lends_to. supplier_of and competes_with are declared but have no source yet: a company's suppliers are the `to` end of customer_of relationships whose `from` is that company.

since.description: Only relationships whose proving filing is dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: 'active' (default): relationships the filings still state — a customer the supplier's latest report still names, a contract not past its stated term; 'all': past ones too, each with its relationshipStatus (not_restated, expired).

view.description: Which relationships (default 'all'): capital (owns, invests_in, holds_rights_in), value_chain (customer_of, agreement_with, acquired, lends_to: who buys, sells, merges with and lends to whom), governance (insider_of), competition (competes_with).
